events.title: Commemorative Air Force Museum Tours
events.description: The CAF-Utah Wing represents living history and is unique among aviation museums. The Utah Wing houses a significant collection of aircraft, authentic World War II artifacts, and women in aviation memorabilia. Items on display in our museum include Allied country uniforms, as well as armament, photographs, weapons, and equipment from both Allied and Axis countries. The Utah Wing of the CAF is a self-supporting, all-volunteer, non-profit, tax-exempt organization registered in Utah. Funds to acquire, restore, maintain and operate aircraft are derived from members' dues, contributions, aircraft sponsors, and fundraising events. All donations, including dues and aircraft sponsorships, are used to support the Wing's museum and to restore, operate, and maintain our Ghost Squadron.

events.description: Live Summer Music Series May through September (weather permitting) Every day but Mondays from 5:30pm – 8:30pm Sundays 10am – 1:30pm Dominick has been playing guitar for 21 years and writing original music for 15+ of those years. He looks at himself not as a guitar player, but an artist who utilizes the guitar and other forms to create an inspiring, healing, and contemplative experience for himself and listeners. Alternate tunings and intuitive playing have contributed immensely by shaping the instrumental and lyrical music that comes through him. He has a background in Integrative Health and is currently studying Music and Recording Arts Technology which is taking his creative possibilities to new depths and heights. He has performed at festivals in Thailand, Costa Rica, and the East Coast (US), as well as in yoga classes, local gigs, and workshops where he incorporates live music, meditation, group energy healing and writing into one experience. events.title: Serve Park City: Barbed Wire Pull on the 910 Ranch
events.description: Join Summit County for a barbed wire pull at the 910 Ranch! Enjoy a hands-on day of stewardship and community connection! We’ll work together to remove decommissioned barbed wire fencing, helping to restore wildlife movement and improve the health of the landscape. What to Bring & Wear: Wear long pants, long sleeves, and sturdy closed-toe shoes or boots. Pack sun protection (hat, sunglasses, sunscreen), water and snacks, and layers in case of changing weather. Please bring sunglasses to act as protective eyewear! Participants should bring thick, sturdy gloves for their protection and wire cutters if they have them. Summit County has a limited number of gloves and wire cutters to borrow. Safety Notice: Participation in barbed wire removal can be dangerous. Hazards may include cuts, punctures, scrapes, tripping, heavy lifting, sharp edges, and exposure to rusted metal or other environmental risks. By signing up and attending this activity, you acknowledge these risks, accept full responsibility for your participation, and agree to the terms of the waiver. A recent tetanus vaccination is recommended, though it is not required. Your safety is our priority—please work carefully, follow instructions, and look out for one another. This is a great opportunity to roll up your sleeves, meet like-minded people, and directly help enhance one of our community’s treasured open spaces....
events.location: 910 Cattle Ranch, Park City, Utah

events.description: The 57th Kimball Arts Festival Returns to Park City Main Street August 7–9! Come see nearly 200 artist booths representing 13 art mediums lining Main Street Park City, 2 stages featuring local musicians, food trucks, art activities, and more! Friday | 5:00 PM–9:00 PM (Summit County Locals get in free!) Saturday | 10:00 AM–8:00 PM Sunday | 10:00 AM–6:00 PM Locals passes, day passes, and VIP pass upgrades (including skybox lounge access, food, exclusive programming, and a private bar) are available. Get tickets now at go.kimballartcenter.org/festival-tickets-2026
